description: A simple checklist app that saves automatically — add tasks, check them off, track your progress bar, and clear completed items.

faqs.a: Yes — your list is saved in this browser's localStorage and restored on every visit.
The progress bar and counts update live as you check items off.
Yes — one button removes all checked items at once.

howto: Type a task and press Add (or Enter).
Check items off as you finish them.
Watch the progress bar fill up.
title: Checklist App
